summary: Reports saved changes reverting after refresh; question unanswered
detailed_context: Nick asked whether the site saves state, because after a refresh it appears to revert to an older version. This is a bug report on work he had already flagged, following an earlier complaint about the step 3 group dropdown. The previous response covered a Firebase sign-in email sender name, which does not address persistence or the Permission Assist page, so the question was effectively ignored. The rating is 3 rather than lower because the message is a question, not an outright rejection, and he has not said the work is unusable. Lesson: when Nick reports a regression, verify the live state and answer the persistence question directly before reporting any other progress.
